workflow_conclusion_reason: Runner exit 2; partial attempts and unsupported catalog modes. Capture and encrypted artifact upload succeeded; no timeout.

scope.eligibility: At least one native complete attempt in the preceding 35-provider campaign
scope.implemented_mode_selection: All implemented modes of the 210 fixed selected games
scope.selection_limit: Fixed directed sample preserving earlier successes and mode diversity; not an unbiased catalog availability estimate.

definitions.complete: Original native completion, consistent terminal attempt_finish and complete bank state, with hashes and metadata verified; financial reconciliation is not a requirement.
definitions.attempt: One configured game/mode sample; initialization may fail before any round action.
definitions.round_action_intent: An outbound event marked round_action; may be a spin, purchase, continuation, choice or collect and does not alone prove acceptance.
definitions.outbound_intent: Recorded HTTP request, WebSocket handshake or WebSocket send; not a count of bets.
definitions.overlap: Observed game/provider activity intervals, not exact simultaneous HTTP requests.
definitions.failure_category: Diagnostic classification of observed responses or adapter guards; not an assertion of the remote root cause.
definitions.partial_replay: All recorded messages can be replayed, but exit 2 preserves the original incomplete round.

diagnostic_revision.basis: Existing captured bodies and launcher headers, contrasted with the exact adapter conditions. Original private package is unchanged.

clarifications.kalamba: All six allowlist stops occur when validating the WebSocket target emitted by the launcher; the document host is already allowed.
clarifications.pragmatic: The source parser groups unlogged and frozen-without-na under one session-unavailable label. This sample contains frozen/SystemError, not unlogged.
clarifications.elk: Three inspected init/purchase/checkwin HTTP 500 bodies are identical generic Internal Server Error pages; the specific backend cause remains unknown.
clarifications.yggdrasil: The five code-1 rejections say Technical problem, please retry.; no specific cause is supplied. These are separate from the eleven unsupported C continuations.
clarifications.peterandsons: The HTTP 400 close response supplies TRANSACTION_REJECTED and Application Error; no specific cause is supplied.
